issue_context.title: Move resource-based priority functions to their Score plugins [Migration Phase 2]
issue_context.body:
/sig scheduling
/priority important-soon

See #86399 as an example.

There are two parts to this:

PR 1: move  RequestedToCapacityRatio plugins/requestedtocapacityratio/requested_to_capacity_ratio.go to plugins/noderesources/requested_to_capacity_ratio.go

PR 2: move resource_allocation.go to plugins/noderesources/ and move the logic in  Least/Most/Balanced and RequestedToCapacityRatio logic to their Score plugins. This needs to be done in a single PR.

Part of #85822

/assign @notpad
comments: Hi @notpad , are you still working on this?
yes, I am working on this

review_comments:
the function should now return ```(int64, framework.Status)``` not ```(framework.NodeScore, error)```

For example, line 55:
```return 0, framework.NewStatus(framework.Error, "node not found")```

This will become something like this:
```
return &LeastAllocated{
  handle: h,
  resourceAllocationScorer: {LeastAllocatedName, leastResourceScorer, DefaultRequestedRatioResources},
 }, nil
```

make it the same as RequestedToCapacityRatio:

```
type MostAllocated struct {
  handle framework.FrameworkHandle
  resourceAllocationScorer
}
```
let change ```ResourceAllocationPriority``` to just ```resourceAllocationScorer``` (i.e., make it local to the package as well as drop the Priority suffix)

make it the same as RequestedToCapacityRatio:

```
type LeastAllocated struct {
  handle framework.FrameworkHandle
  resourceAllocationScorer
}
```
